description: Adds a typed field at the end of the collection’s field order. `key` is lowercase snake_case (max 64 characters), must be unique in the collection, and cannot use the reserved metadata names `id`, `slug`, `publishedAt`, `publishAt`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, or `position`; `type` is immutable after creation. `reference` and `multi_reference` fields require a `targetCollectionId` in the same website, and `option` fields require `config.choices` (1–1,000 choices). A collection can hold at most 100 fields, and `required: true` is rejected while the collection has active items — add the field as optional, backfill every item, then mark it required.
name: cms_fields_create
title: Add a field to a collection
